headline: Set bonuses, off-hands, bare fists, and a lot more in the damage calc.
notes: Set bonuses turn on by themselves once you wear enough pieces, and the armory shows which tiers you've reached.
Off-hand weapons are their own weapon now, with their own stats, effects and weight. Basic attacks in the damage calc can pick a hand.
No main weapon means Bare Fists. Empty Palm, Kickboxing Shoes, Arcane Tattoo (Fist), Hidden Blade, Hidden Barrage and Tendril Tonic all work with them.
The damage calc adds on-hit damage from your weapon and gear, race, torso and boss bonuses, spell school Power, and flat crit damage.
Church Faithful's +15% healing applies to healing skills.
Fixed set bonuses stacking per piece, crit damage read as Critical, and basic-attack-only Power applying to everything.
